QuestInfo.name: Central Robot Aufheben
QuestInfo.1: Andy has requested that you travel to the ruins of the city in the year 2216 and defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controls all electronic devices in the city. Andy says if Dunas was an android, it is very likely that Aufheben is also an android.
QuestInfo.2: Andy requested that you travel to the ruins of the city in the year 2216 and defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controlled all electronic devices in the city. As suspected, Aufheben was an android. The battle between humans and robots seems interminable.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 111,300\nThe New and Improved Oberon now available.\n

0.0: This is already your 4th journey through time. Don't forget, your mission is to eliminate Aufheben. Aufheben is one of the main robots that attacked the city, and the one responsible for destroying all our electronics. It probably looks similar to Dunas. Can you do it?

yes.0: Aufheben is strong beyond your imagination. It won't be easy destroying Aufheben. Best wishes.

no.0: Are you not ready? Now, that's a problem. We don't have much time left.

1.0: You're getting stronger and stronger. I can't believe you've defeated Aufheben. You are a true hero and an incredible time traveler.

mob.0: Please defeat Aufheben, the central robot that controls all electronic devices in town. That might be the last step to changing the past and setting things right.
